title: Creative Inquiry + Mountaintop Initiative (Lehigh University)
description:
Creative Inquiry is Lehigh's campus-wide home for student-driven, interdisciplinary research and creative work. Anchored by the Mountaintop Initiative, it helps undergraduates in any major design and lead impact-focused projects with faculty mentors and external partners, and points them to fellowships, grants, and summer research experiences.

From the program page: Converge, Create Collaborate on authentic projects that solve real problems, advance knowledge, and improve the human condition.
